pages.description: At Vogueritual, we believe online shopping should be accessible and convenient for customers with different abilities and needs.

blocks.text: At Vogueritual, we believe online shopping should be accessible and convenient for customers with different abilities and needs.
We aim to improve website usability for people using assistive technologies, keyboards, and other accessibility features.

sections.title: Our accessibility objectives include making it easier for customers to:

blocks.text: Browse products
Navigate categories
Use search
Review product information
Manage shopping carts
Complete checkout
Access customer support
Read store policies

This statement does not represent a verified certification or claim that every page currently conforms to WCAG 2.2 AA.
Consistent menus
Descriptive links
Logical headings
Understandable instructions
Clear page structures
We aim to support keyboard access to essential website functionality, including forms, navigation, shopping carts, and checkout.
We aim to improve compatibility with commonly used screen readers and assistive technologies.
Readable typography
Clear content organization
Appropriate contrast
Logical heading structures
Understandable labels
We aim to provide useful alternative text for informative images.
Decorative images may be marked appropriately.
We recognize the importance of accessible forms and payment interfaces.
We aim to improve field labels, error messages, navigation, and interactive controls.
We aim to provide usable layouts on mobile phones and tablets.
Our website may rely on third-party tools for payment processing, customer support, or other functionality.
Some third-party components may have accessibility limitations outside our direct control.
